spec-to-story.expectations: Decompose the specification document comprehensively to generate detailed, distinct user stories in the format: 'As a [role], I want to [action], So that [benefit]'.

user-stories.expectations: Compile the stories and tasks into a tabular format structured for direct JIRA import. Ensure proper classification of Story, Task, and Bug issues.

ux-wireframe.expectations: Generate raw, standalone HTML/CSS code for high-fidelity interactive wireframes. Apply elegant styling, responsive card structures, and realistic placeholder data.

functional-spec.expectations: Draft a comprehensive Functional Specification Document in HTML format detailing objectives, user personas, system workflows, and operational rules.

tech-architecture.expectations: Produce technical designs including system components, sequence flows, data models, third-party integrations, and infrastructure blueprints.

database-design.expectations: Generate complete database entity definitions, relationship mapping via Mermaid ERD syntax, and a clean PostgreSQL SQL DDL deployment script.

test-cases.expectations: Generate test scenarios, negative/boundary test suites, regression test cases, and high-coverage test cases formatted in a clean HTML dashboard.

traceability-matrix.expectations: Construct a traceability matrix mapping Requirement IDs to User Stories, database schemas, and corresponding test cases to verify 100% specification coverage.
